headline: BKR Q2 Deep Dive: Chart Acquisition and Power Demand Drive Strategic Shift
summary: Energy technology company Baker Hughes (NASDAQ:BKR) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 2.4% year on year to $6.74 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.64 per share was 31.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
